descriptions.en: A read-only Home Assistant custom integration that shows Chirp disk SMART health, disk and CPU temperatures, and host memory, load, network, power, fan and voltage metrics.
descriptions.ko: Chirp 서버의 디스크 SMART 건강 상태·디스크와 CPU 온도, 호스트 메모리·부하·네트워크·전력·팬·전압 지표를 읽기 전용으로 연결하는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합입니다.

description.en: The self-hosted disk and CPU monitor this integration connects to.
description.ko: 이 통합이 연결하는 셀프호스팅 디스크·CPU 모니터 서버입니다.

categories_review.source: Chirp is a self-hosted host monitor: it reports disk SMART health, disk temperatures and CPU temperature (README.md, custom_components/chirp/sensor.py). computers_network.monitoring is the primary product use; no secondary category is needed because nothing is controlled and it is not a NAS or router integration. Reviewed 2026-11-03.
